title: Followers of Horus secret societies preserving knowledge from the First Time

tellings.quote: that these were secret societies which were entrusted with preserving information from what they call the first time and passing it down to future generations.

plain: The "Followers of Horus" of ancient Egypt are said to have been secret societies whose job was to keep knowledge from what the Egyptians called "the First Time", a remote founding age, and to pass it down to later generations. The writer Graham Hancock lays this out on the show, drawing on Robert Bauval and the book Talisman. If it is true, knowledge from a lost earlier age was handed down in secret.
